definition: Deep Learning Studio is a software tool that aims to simplify the creation of deep learning models used in artificial intelligence.
details: It is compatible with a number of open-source programming frameworks popularly used in artificial neural networks, including MXNet and Google's TensorFlow. Prior to the release of Deep Learning Studio in January 2017, proficiency in Python, among other programming languages, was essential in developing effective deep learning models. Deep Learning Studio sought to simplify the model creation process through a visual, drag-and-drop interface and the application of pre-trained learning models on available data. Irving, Texas–based Deep Cognition Inc. is the developer behind Deep Learning Studio. In 2017, the software allowed Deep Cognition to become a finalist for Best Innovation in Deep Learning in the Alconics Awards, which are given annually to the best artificial intelligence software. Deep Cognition launched version 2.0 of Deep Learning Studio at NVIDIA's GTC 2018 Conference in San Jose, California. Fremont, California–based computing products supplier Exxact Corp provides desktop computers specifically built to handle Deep Learning Studio workloads.

explainer.lead: Deep Learning Studio is a visual tool from Deep Cognition for creating deep-learning models without building everything in code. Its drag-and-drop interface and support for pre-trained models were intended to make model development more approachable while working with frameworks such as MXNet and TensorFlow.

tiers.eli5: Deep Learning Studio is like building a model from visible blocks instead of writing lots of computer instructions. You can arrange the pieces on a screen and start with a model that has already learned something, then use it with your data.
tiers.practitioner: An engineer would assemble a model through the visual interface, optionally apply a pre-trained model to available data, and work within an MXNet or TensorFlow-compatible workflow. The tool reduces the need to write model-building code in Python, but it is a development interface rather than a replacement for those underlying frameworks.
tiers.paperLevel: Deep Learning Studio is a model-construction software layer: given available data D and a model assembled visually or initialized from a pre-trained model, it supports deep-learning development through MXNet or TensorFlow. Its distinguishing mechanism is the drag-and-drop interface, not a new learning algorithm; version 2.0 was launched at NVIDIA's GTC 2018 conference.

explainer.example: Suppose you have an image collection and want to build a deep-learning model for it. In Deep Learning Studio, you could assemble the model visually and apply a pre-trained model to the collection, using an MXNet or TensorFlow-compatible workflow instead of writing the entire model in Python.

usedIn.name: Deep-learning model development
usedIn.detail: Used to construct models visually and apply pre-trained models to available data with MXNet or TensorFlow compatibility.

usedIn.name: Exxact desktop computers
usedIn.detail: Exxact Corp provides desktop computers built specifically to handle Deep Learning Studio workloads.

explainer.intuition: The central idea is to turn model creation into a visual assembly task. Instead of writing the whole model in a programming language such as Python, a user can arrange components and build on pre-trained models.
howItWorks: Start with the data available for the deep-learning task.
Use the drag-and-drop interface to assemble a model visually.
Where useful, apply a pre-trained learning model to that data rather than starting entirely from scratch.
Develop the model in a workflow compatible with open-source frameworks such as MXNet or TensorFlow.
explainer.whyItMatters: It sought to lower the programming barrier to deep-learning development at a time when proficiency in Python and other languages was essential. Deep Cognition became a finalist for Best Innovation in Deep Learning at the 2017 AIconics Awards through the software.
misconceptions: It is not itself a deep-learning framework; it works with frameworks including MXNet and TensorFlow.
It is not a single pre-trained model; it is a tool that can apply pre-trained models to data.
Its visual interface does not make it a new deep-learning algorithm.

diagram.caption: Deep Learning Studio combines available data, visual model assembly, and optional pre-trained models within workflows compatible with MXNet or TensorFlow.
